reason: Original raw proposal is preserved. The florin/intermediate-carrier/prohibition/near-weight obligations apply ONLY if a whole reading explicitly selects that particular source recipe. They are NOT necessary conditions for generic SOL=gold, and their absence cannot refute gold generally. Direct source evidence for actual celestial versus mineral Sol senses is distinct from target recipe ownership. Scientific novelty and target realization remain unreviewed and untested.

blockers.detail: Not a gate against exploratory gold hypotheses. The source account can be explored conditionally; no evidence has yet selected this exact florin recipe as the meaning of an admitted target.

not_sufficient: A Sun/gold name equivalence alone selecting the particular florin recipe
Absence of this specific carrier route treated as refutation of gold generally

design.unit: Root-owned complete admitted astronomical and medicinal contexts; broad material/celestial alternatives first. A particular historical recipe is a separately declared conditional account.
design.prediction: ONLY AFTER selecting the florin recipe as a whole account: preserve the same solid donor A, its repeated contact with intermediate B, subsequent B-in-C mixing, prohibition of direct A-in-C quenching, and near-equal coin weight. Before such selection these are source possibilities, not target obligations.
design.contrast: At the broad level: material versus celestial senses need a compositional distinction, not name substitution alone. At the specifically selected florin level: direct-transfer and consumed-donor variants conflict with that source account. Other gold recipes are not excluded.
